title: A Mayer-Vietoris calculus for regular denominators
summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $I$ be an ideal. An element $a\in A$ is a regular denominator for $I$ when multiplication by $a$ on $A/I$ is injective; we denote the set of all such elements by $S_I$. We study how the common regular denominators for two ideals $I$ and $J$ are related to $I\cap J$ and $I+J$. This yields a particularly simple description when $I$ and $J$ are comaximal.
